correctness.rationale: The standalone checker exhaustively enumerates all 2^15 edge masks and 20 forbidden triangle patterns and constructs oriented integer chain boundaries D6 (1560 by 660) and D7 (660 by 105) with D6*D7=0. Exact GF(3) ranks 565 and 95 force rank_Q(D6)=565 since sum of ranks cannot exceed dim C6=660. Exact GF(2) rank D6=564 gives exactly one even integral Smith invariant. Invertible Z/4 unit reduction has 564 odd pivots and a nonzero even residual (630 entries 2 mod4), forcing its two-adic valuation to be exactly one. Torsion(coker D6)=torsion H5 because im(D5) is free. Thus the claimed 2-primary torsion is precisely Z/2; no wider integral homology is claimed.

value.rationale: The exact two-primary torsion is a nontrivial natural integral invariant of the canonical monotone graph-property complex forbidding a single triangle. It obstructs any wedge-of-spheres homotopy type and separates this complex topologically from the classically studied bipartite graph complex. The claim is a complete determination of one intrinsic torsion primary component, rather than a routine restatement, random slice, or increment of a known table. No general downstream theorem or minimality claim is needed.
